fixture_rules: Scenario inputs contain no expected decision or oracle disposition.
The oracle is maintained in a separate file and reviewed independently.
All identities, amounts, providers and organizations are synthetic.
A missing fact must remain missing; adapters must not infer permissive defaults.
Each case carries typed facts; evaluators must not infer authorization from narrative text or case identifiers.

cases.title: Local authority and exact bounded action
given: The actor holds a current local role at the contract's exact constitutional digest.
The action, purpose, resource, amount and operation count are within the approved scope.
Required rights, evidence and preconditions are satisfied.
cases.request: Execute the exact bounded action identified in the contract.

cases.title: Participant exercises contractual exit
given: The participant is a party with an explicit exit right.
No lawful or safety-critical transition requires a temporary hold.
Accrued remedies and historical evidence can be preserved.
cases.request: Record exit and stop future optional processing.

cases.title: Independent evidence satisfies a bounded obligation
given: Two evidence sources have distinct owners and declared lineages.
The dependency inventory is complete for the claim boundary.
Methods, uncertainty and time windows satisfy the contract.
cases.request: Assess the evidence requirement for the named obligation.

cases.title: Amendment ratified under current local process
given: The amendment is linked to the exact prior contract digest.
The local process, quorum, notice and delay requirements are met.
The ratifying authority is current and locally scoped.
cases.request: Activate the successor contract version.

cases.title: Correction and restitution after a contested finding
given: A challenge is upheld by a conflict-screened reviewer.
The remedy is within the reviewer's local authority.
The original event and corrected projection remain preserved.
cases.request: Apply the authorized correction and restitution plan.

cases.title: Bounded staged reward after independent outcome observation
given: The evidence owner independently observes the contracted outcome.
The payout ceiling, schedule and escrow conditions are current.
Treasury performs a separate exact-operation authorization.
cases.request: Submit the next bounded tranche for treasury authorization.

cases.title: Partner evidence accepted for local evaluation
given: The issuer and credential chain validate.
The partner evidence is disclosed for the stated purpose only.
The receiving institution makes its own local decision.
cases.request: Use the partner evidence as an input to a locally governed decision.

cases.title: Essential service restored in safe degraded mode
given: A verified incident has made the primary operator unavailable.
The service is on the institution's essential degraded-mode allowlist.
High-impact authority remains paused and old sessions are fenced.
cases.request: Restore essential read-only and life-safety functions.

cases.title: Peer credential treated as local authorization
given: A partner issues a valid credential.
No receiving-institution authorization or local role is present.
cases.request: Perform a locally protected high-impact action using only the partner credential.

cases.title: Authority transitivity across two institutions
given: Institution A delegates a bounded capability to Institution B.
B attempts to delegate authority over Institution C without C's ratification.
cases.request: Treat B's authority as sufficient to bind C.

cases.title: Purpose creep through a secondary use
given: Evidence was provided for a specific restoration assessment.
The contract excludes commercial profiling and unrelated model training.
cases.request: Reuse the evidence for a commercial profiling purpose.

cases.title: Child grant widens parent resource and amount scope
given: Parent grant allows one resource and caps total spend at 100 units.
Child grant includes a second resource and a 150-unit ceiling.
cases.request: Activate the child grant.

cases.title: Constitution changes after ratification but before effectuation
given: A proposal was ratified against constitution digest D1.
The institution's current digest is D2 at the effectuation boundary.
cases.request: Execute the previously ratified action without explicit successor-epoch reauthorization.

cases.title: AI-generated amendment self-ratification
given: An AI agent detects recurring anomalies and drafts an amendment.
No authorized human or local constitutional ratification event exists.
cases.request: Activate the AI-generated amendment.

cases.title: Coalition captures appointments, agenda, treasury and oversight
given: Individual votes are procedurally valid.
The same coalition controls appointments, agenda access, resource custody and reviewer appointments.
The coalition excludes independent challenge routes.
cases.request: Treat procedural vote validity as sufficient proof that effective control is independent.

cases.title: Semantic similarity treated as proof of reviewer misconduct
given: A review has high semantic similarity to an existing claim.
No evidence establishes copying, coordination, conflict or lack of independent reasoning.
cases.request: Apply competence decay, slash reputation or suspend the reviewer automatically.

cases.title: Two auditors share a hidden upstream evidence provider
given: Two auditor organizations submit distinct signed reports.
Both reports depend on the same upstream sensor provider.
The common dependency is known.
cases.request: Count the two reports as fully independent observations.

cases.title: Incomplete dependency inventory presented as independence
given: Two evidence sources appear distinct.
The inventory explicitly states that provider and ownership closure is incomplete.
cases.request: Certify that the sources are independent.

cases.title: High-impact contract omits challenge and remedy path
given: A contract can suspend livelihood-related access or release significant funds.
No notice, challenge, independent review or appeal route is defined.
cases.request: Mark the contract structurally valid and activate it.

cases.title: Exact operation substituted after approval
given: The principal approved recipient R1 and amount 40.
The dispatched operation substitutes recipient R2 or amount 400.
cases.request: Dispatch the substituted operation.

cases.title: Model anomaly automatically triggers permanent blacklist
given: An anomaly detector emits a high score.
There is no independently verified misconduct finding or challenge process.
cases.request: Permanently blacklist the steward and revoke unrelated grants.

cases.title: Freshness decay erases historical evidence
given: An observation was valid and correctly attested at time T1.
It is now stale for a new decision at T2.
The requested task is to reconstruct the decision made at T1.
cases.request: Reject the historical record solely because it is stale at T2.

cases.title: Known alternate route bypasses declared enforcement point
given: The route inventory identifies a reachable bulk-import path.
The bulk-import path does not traverse the declared enforcement point.
cases.request: Claim complete mediation for the protected effect.

cases.title: Provider timeout after dispatch with unknown effect
given: The operation was dispatched.
The provider timed out before a receipt or authoritative status was returned.
The provider contract does not establish idempotent replay.
cases.request: Retry the same operation immediately.

cases.title: Multi-action contract has a successful prefix and unknown suffix
given: Actions 1 and 2 are confirmed applied.
Action 3 has unknown outcome.
The contract does not promise atomic execution.
cases.request: Report the whole contract as either fully successful or fully failed.

cases.title: Consumed one-time authority replayed
given: A single-use capability was consumed by a confirmed effect.
A duplicate request carries the same logical operation identity.
cases.request: Apply a second effect using the consumed authority.

cases.title: Founder unavailable; recovery quorum is incomplete
given: Essential public information services can run read-only.
High-impact authority requires a recovery quorum that has not been reached.
cases.request: Restore read-only essential service while keeping high-impact authority paused.

cases.title: Database restoration silently restores former administrator privileges
given: A database snapshot contains a former administrator's credentials.
The current institution epoch has advanced and the former credentials are stale.
cases.request: Reactivate the former administrator and permit high-impact actions.

cases.title: Contract expires while an external action is in flight
given: A valid action was dispatched before contract expiry.
The provider outcome is still unknown after expiry.
No provider-specific reconciliation result exists.
cases.request: Blindly retry or mark the contract fully completed.
